title: Servicetechniker (m/w/d) – Großbatteriespeicher/ EMSR-Technik
description: Über uns Ohne Speicher keine Energiewende. ju:niz Energy entwickelt und betreibt seit über zehn Jahren netzdienliche Großbatteriespeicher. Unsere Anlagen stabilisieren das Stromnetz und schaffen die Flexibilität, die eine Energieversorgung mit erneuerbaren Energien braucht. Wir investieren selbst in unsere Projekte und behalten die Speicher langfristig im Bestand. Für unser Operations-Team suchen wir dich als Servicetechniker (m/w/d). Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Anlagen sicher und zuverlässig laufen. Du kannst überall in Deutschland wohnen: Von deinem Wohnort aus betreust du unsere Anlagen im gesamten Bundesgebiet. Je nach Einsatzplanung gehören auch mehrtägige Touren mit Übernachtung dazu. Aufgaben, die keine Anwesenheit an der Anlage erfordern, kannst du von zu Hause erledigen. Deine Aufgaben An unseren Großbatteriespeichern und elektrotechnischen Nebenanlagen führst du Wartungen, Inspektionen und Instandsetzungen durch. Tritt eine Störung auf, grenzt du die Ursache systematisch ein, behebst den Fehler und tauschst bei Bedarf Komponenten aus – vor Ort oder, soweit möglich, per Fernzugriff. Mithilfe von SCADA-, EMS- und Fernwirksystemen überwachst und parametrierst du unsere Anlagen. Bei Inbetriebnahmen, Funktionstests, Netztests und Upgrades bringst du deine technische Erfahrung ein und führst Prüfungen im Rahmen deiner Qualifikation durch. Deine Einsätze, Messergebnisse und Lösungen hältst du nachvollziehbar fest. Wiederkehrende Fehler und Verbesserungspotenziale besprichst du mit dem Operations-Team, damit unsere Anlagen langfristig zuverlässig laufen. Dein Profil Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im elektrotechnischen Bereich bildet deine Grundlage – zum Beispiel als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik oder Mechatroniker mit elektrotechnischer Erfahrung. In der Wartung oder Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen, industrieller Steuerungen oder Energieanlagen hast du bereits praktische Erfahrung gesammelt. Kenntnisse von Batteriespeichern sind willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Schaltpläne und technische Dokumentation liest du sicher; bei der Fehlersuche gehst du strukturiert vor. Erfahrung mit EMSR-Technik, SCADA, EMS oder Kommunikationsprotokollen wie Modbus und IEC 61850 ist ein Plus. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten liegt dir. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B. Für Einsätze an unseren Anlagen reist du innerhalb Deutschlands. Auch mehrtägige Touren mit Übernachtung sind für dich grundsätzlich möglich. Warum wir? Technik mit Wirkung: Deine Arbeit trägt dazu bei, dass Großbatteriespeicher zuverlässig funktionieren und das Stromnetz stabilisieren. Abwechslungsreiche Einsätze: Dich erwarten unterschiedliche Anlagen und Aufgaben – von der Fehleranalyse bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Deutschlandweiter Einstieg: Dein Wohnort muss nicht in der Nähe unseres Büros in Aschheim liegen. Fachliche Entwicklung: Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen in der Batterietechnik und im Anlagenbetrieb weiter ausbauen. Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest mit einem kollegialen Team und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Kontakt Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann. Dein Ansprechpartner Moritz Erlbeck People Growth & Hiring Lead ju:niz Energy GmbH Einsteinring 43 85609 Aschheim Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Berlin, Germany
description: <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.</p> <p>Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App.&nbsp;Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API,&nbsp;payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50&nbsp;million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.</p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent&nbsp;across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment.&nbsp;Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our&nbsp;request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products&nbsp;depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or&nbsp;someone gets charged twice.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of&nbsp;you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one.&nbsp;That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling&nbsp;except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by&nbsp;taking scope and being right about it, fast.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption&nbsp;tracking, and our public TTS API</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it&nbsp;correct after you've moved on</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that&nbsp;freed you up for</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the&nbsp;product is going</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)</li> <li>Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it&nbsp;created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended,&nbsp;what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone</li> <li>The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual&nbsp;request — rather than against a summary of it</li> <li>Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it</li> <li>A preference for being corrected over being right</li> <li>Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments</li> <li>Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to&nbsp;finish within a week.</p> <p>The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this&nbsp;team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk&nbsp;through your reasoning, so bring it.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li>A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li>Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li>The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li>Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li>The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li>An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Germany Based </strong>Salary range for this role is: 30,000-120,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.</p><p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. <br>And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.</p> <p><strong>Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Refer them!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer - Personalization
description: <h2 style="text-align: left;">About The Opportunity</h2> <p>Become part of the Contentful Personalization Team and help shape how leading businesses deliver personalized digital user experiences.</p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you will solve complex customer problems and deliver value through end-to-end personalization solutions. You will work across high-performance backend services, developer-facing frontend tools and SDKs, infrastructure, and observability to help customers deliver personalized content experiences in a performant, reliable, and developer-friendly way.</p> <p>You will bring a proactive approach to problem-solving, a high sense of ownership, and a continuous improvement mindset. You will use modern AI tools, including agentic coding workflows, thoughtfully to improve how you explore, build, test, and maintain software. You will also contribute actively to the team's Agile ways of working, understanding how planning, refinement, delivery, reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement fit together.</p> <h2 style="text-align: left;">What To Expect?</h2> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services and APIs with a focus on reliability, scalability, and low latency.</li> <li>Deliver end-to-end solutions across backend services, React-based frontend experiences, and developer-facing SDKs, libraries, and tools.</li> <li>Implement complex CDN and edge-based caching solutions that allow users to retrieve personalized content in the most performant way.</li> <li>Solve technical challenges in creative ways, balancing the trade-off between performance and elegant software architecture.</li> <li>Continuously monitor and optimize system performance through benchmarking, while making sure systems are well instrumented for observability.</li> <li>Implement defensive coding practices and guarantee correctness and maintainable code through automated testing.</li> <li>Use AI-assisted and agentic coding tools responsibly to improve engineering workflows, while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, testing, and review.</li> <li>Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives, to help the team deliver customer value and continuously improve.</li> <li>Stay up to date with the latest technologies and constantly evaluate their potential use at Contentful.</li> </ul> <h2 raw.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
raw.description:
Mission

Founded in 2024 by Lukas Zörner and Anil Can Baykal, Integral set out to redefine how accounting, taxation and payroll works for SMEs in Europe, starting with Germany. The company is backed by General Catalyst, Cherry Ventures, Puzzle Ventures and entrepreneurs across Europe.

As Senior DevOps Engineer, you will help us build trustworthy product experiences that solve real customer problems on payroll, tax and accounting. Own outcomes, not just output, balancing speed and craftsmanship to deliver value that compounds using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain our cloud infrastructure with a focus on reliability, scalability and security

  • Own our CI/CD pipelines end-to-end — from design to rollout and continuous improvement

  • Drive infrastructure-as-code practices across the engineering team

  • Collaborate closely with product and AI engineers to enable fast, safe and frequent deployments

  • Monitor system performance, lead incident response and run post-mortems to keep raising the bar

  • Instrument infrastructure with observability tooling — logs, metrics, traces — and act on what you see

  • Ensure security and compliance standards are met across all environments

  • Balance short-term delivery with long-term architectural investments

  • Drive simplicity: reduce complexity for developers and keep systems easy to reason about

  • High ownership: you'll have a real say in how we build and scale our infrastructure

  • Your decisions directly impact the reliability and performance of a platform used by thousands of SMEs across Europe

  • Tight feedback loops with engineers, founders and stakeholders

  • Pragmatic pace: ship, learn, iterate

 

Core responsibilities

Experience & Mindset

  • 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or Cloud Infrastructure roles, ideally at a startup or high-growth company

  • Proven track record of owning infrastructure end-to-end and driving measurable impact

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you take initiative, manage your own time, and leave systems and teams better than you found them

  • You turn complexity into simplicity, make good decisions reversible, and build plans others can follow

  • Comfortable leveraging AI coding tools such as Cursor, Copilot or Claude — and able to audit and validate AI-generated code

  • Experience in fast-scaling environments is a strong plus

  • German language skills are a strong plus

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP preferred)

  • Containerisation and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes

  • CI/CD tooling: GitHub Actions, CircleCI, ArgoCD or similar

  • Infrastructure-as-code: Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent

  • Observability: logs, metrics, traces; familiarity with SLOs and incident response

  • Security basics: authN/authZ, secrets management, threat modelling, secure coding practices

  • Familiarity with Python is a strong plus, our engineers work heavily with Python and Claude

The process

1. Intro Call with our Talent Team
2. Deep dive Interview with our CTO & co-founder
3. On-site Coding Interview at our Berlin office with the engineering team
4. Founder Conversation with our CEO & co-founder

Our offer

  • Above-market salary

  • Direct line to the Founders: no filter, no queue, no committee

  • Total autonomy on what you build; we measure hours saved

  • The best tools, no questions asked: Claude Max, Cursor, OpenAI, whatever ships next week

  • Internal tools and resources purpose-built to support agentic AI development at scale, read about how we work at engineering.integral.de

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club membership, coupons (Sachbezüge) to over 200 partners or Deutschlandticket, your choice

  • Best equipment for you to succeed

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, right next to Mauerpark

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8pm

  • A team of 50+ (and growing!) ambitious, diverse people, 20%+ ex-founders learning and building together

We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status.

raw.title: Senior FP&A Manager
raw.description:
Mission

Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there.

As our first dedicated Senior FP&A Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build.

 

Your Tasks

  • Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic.

  • Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds.

  • Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early.

  • IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials.

  • GTM & cohorts: Build and own cohort analytics tied to go-to-market (e.g. retention, payback period, LTV/CAC and margin by acquisition channel). Turn these into concrete recommendations on spend and channel mix.

  • Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions.

  • Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable.

 

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure.

  • Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions.

  • Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions.

  • Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning and AI tooling a strong plus.

  • Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English.

  • Mindset: Hands-on, structured, comfortable with ambiguity and first-of-role ownership in a scaling environment.

  • Agentic mindset: You default to AI and agentic tools to automate the repetitive and build leverage - you think in reusable processes and systems, not one-off spreadsheets, so finance scales faster than headcount.

  • Qualification: Degree in finance, business or a quantitative field; CFA, MBA or qualified-accountant background welcome.

What we're not looking for

  • People who wait to be told what to do.

  • "That's not my job" energy at the handoff between teams.

  • Anyone who treats compliance and documentation as red tape to skip rather than the thing that protects the client.

 

Process

We move fast. For the right candidate the whole process takes less than two weeks.

  1. Virtual call ​with our Talent Team

  2. Virtual Case Study based on a real challenge we're facing that you'd solve

  3. Invitation to our office to meet the team, product, and run through your case study

  4. Reference call

 

Our Offer

  • Direct line to the CFO and Co-Founder/CEO exposure

  • Competitive compensation package

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Sachbezüge/Coupons to over 200 partners or a Deutschland Ticket

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern equipment setup for your needs to succeed

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8 p.m.

  • A team of 50+ (and growing) ambitious, diverse experts, 20%+ ex-founders, learning and building together

  • A category-defining growth story in a large, underserved market, with an AI-enabled operating model.

We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status.

raw.description:
Mission

Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there.

As Senior Product Builder, you own a core area of the product end to end. You work alongside top-tier engineers and build with them: you write specs, prototype ideas, and ship, using AI tools the way an engineer does.

You sit with users, find what slows them down, and give them that time back. The domain is complex and heavily regulated, so getting it right means holding several things at once: what the user needs, how Ops works today, and what the rules demand. AI makes a product like this possible. The bar is whether it's genuinely good for the people who use it.

You work in a small team, close to the founders. Onsite in our Berlin Prenzlauer Berg office.


Core Responsibilities

  • Build, not just decide. Prototype your ideas, ship features with engineering, and stay close enough to the code to make real product calls.

  • Learn the domain cold. Sit with accountants, watch how the work actually happens, and learn German bookkeeping well enough to know what "correct" means before you build it.

  • Get the workflows right. Accounting and payroll have to be correct, auditable, and traceable. You set that bar and check it against real client data.

  • Decide how AI fits. Work out what AI can own today, what stays with a person, and how that line moves as models improve. Design workflows that get better as the technology does.

  • Free people from the grunt work. Turn today's manual steps into agents that handle them, cut exception handling, shorten time to close, and measure the hours saved.

  • Own your area. Discovery, prioritisation, release, iteration. You call what ships and when.

What makes it special:

  • You build a product area that sits at the center of what Integral does, and you actually build it.

  • You work directly with the CTO and a senior engineering team that ships fast and cares about craft.

  • You're early enough that the big product decisions are still open.

  • Your work reaches thousands of business founders who run their finances on Integral.


Your Profile

  • You build. You prototype your own ideas, you can take them most of the way yourself, and you'd rather ship a rough version than write a long doc about it.

  • You use AI tools effectively, to build and not just to chat, or you're hungry to learn.

  • You've taken products from 0 to 1 and know what that actually takes.

  • You move on your own, think in systems, and bring clarity to messy domains.

  • You hold a high bar without chasing perfection. You ship, learn, and improve.

  • You're fluent in German and English.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in fintech, or building software for accounting, payroll, banking, or other money-movement domains.

  • A track record with genuinely complex systems: lots of state, edge cases, and integrations, where getting the details wrong has real consequences.

  • A working feel for German tax and regulatory requirements for small businesses.


The Hiring Process

We move fast. The full process takes less than two weeks.

  1. Intro call with a member of our team

  2. Meeting Lukas, our co-founder and hiring manager

  3. Take-home case study with 5 days turnaround time

  4. On-site in Berlin: meet the team, work through the case study together, meet Anil and an office tour

  5. Reference calls


Our Offer

  • Above-market salary

  • Direct line to the Founders: no filter, no queue, no committee

  • Total autonomy on what you build; we measure hours saved

  • The best tools, no questions asked: Claude Max, Cursor, OpenAI, whatever ships next week

  • Internal tools and resources purpose-built to support agentic AI development at scale, read about how we work at engineering.integral.de

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club membership, Sachbezug to over 200+ partner companies, or Deutschlandticket

  • Laptop of your choice: MacBook Pro or Windows

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Mitte, right next to Mauerpark

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights

  • A team of 50+ (and growing!) ambitious, diverse people, 20%+ ex-founders learning and building together

We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status.

description: Hamburg · hybrid · Vollzeit · ab sofort Du baust den Shop einer Supplement-Marke, die gerade erst anfängt — und behältst ihn. Qstar ist The Performance Standard: Performance-Nutrition aus Hamburg für Menschen, die im Job, im Training und im Alltag viel leisten. Sechs Kategorien, jedes Hero-Produkt in Taste und Clean, zu jedem Produkt ein Dossier, produziert in Deutschland. Hinter Qstar steht ein Gründerteam, das große Marken dieser Kategorie mit aufgebaut hat. Wir sind finanziert, im Aufbau und verkaufen direkt. Aufgaben Die Rolle Unser Shop läuft auf Shopify und wird in den nächsten Monaten von zwei Produkten auf ein Sortiment von rund 60 Artikeln wachsen, mit Bundles, individuellen Landingpages und weiteren Features. Du bist die Person, der dieser Shop gehört. Du setzt selbst um, holst dir freie Programmierer, wenn es Code braucht, und koordinierst Design, Klaviyo, Tracking, Paid und Apps. Du kennst die Supplement-Kategorie von innen — Produkte, Zielgruppe und Regeln. Was du machst Du baust die Plattform: Theme, Sektionen, Templates für Kategorie, Produkt, Bundle, Dossier und Landingpages — auf einem Datenmodell, das 200 Artikel trägt. Du gestaltest den Kaufweg: Editions- und Geschmackswahl, Abo-Logik, Warenkorb, Checkout, Nachbestellung — im Ton der Marke. Du optimierst systematisch: CRO über den gesamten Funnel, A/B-Tests, Landingpages, die zu den Paid-Kampagnen passen — du weißt, welche Hebel im Supplement-Commerce wirklich ziehen. Du machst Launches wiederholbar: Naming, Health-Claim-Check (was darf aufs Label und in die Copy, was nicht), Dossier, Bilder, Metafelder, Launch-Flow — ein Prozess statt Handarbeit. Du verbindest den Shop mit Klaviyo, damit aus Erstkäufen Routinen werden. Du misst: Tracking-Plan, Consent, ein Wochenreport, dem alle vertrauen. Du briefst und steuerst Freelancer für Code, Design-Umsetzung, Klaviyo und Tracking — und nimmst ab. Qualifikation Was du mitbringst Du kommst aus dem Supplement- bzw. Sports-Nutrition-E-Commerce und hast einen Supplement-Shop schon operativ mit aufgebaut oder skaliert — nicht „E-Commerce allgemein“, sondern genau diese Kategorie. Idealerweise von einer der führenden Marken der Branche. Jung, hungrig, dynamisch — und du weißt aus Erfahrung, was in dieser Kategorie funktioniert und was nicht. Shopify, CRO, Klaviyo und Paid Ads beherrschst du wirklich, hands-on und mit Ergebnissen: Theme-Anpassungen, Metafelder, Apps, Abo-Tools, Funnel- und Conversion-Optimierung, E-Mail-/SMS-Flows, Performance-Kampagnen. Du kennst dich mit Health Claims aus: Was darf man bei Supplements kommunizieren, was nicht — und du baust Launches, die sauber und trotzdem verkaufsstark sind. Du verstehst die Zielgruppe: ihre Pain Points, ihre Sprache, die ganze Fitness- und Supplement-Bubble. Erfahrung mit Bundle- und Abo-Modellen. Du hast schon einmal einen Shop mit Freelancern aufgebaut oder relauncht und weißt, was du selbst machst und was du briefst. Zahlen im Griff: Conversion, AOV, Wiederkauf. Du kannst mit festen Markenregeln arbeiten und sagst uns, wenn eine Conversion-Idee die Marke beschädigt. Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Hamburg oder hybrid, kurze Kündigungsfrist ist ein Vorteil. Benefits Was wir bieten Ein Shop, den du von Anfang an prägst und der mit dem Sortiment wächst, genau wie deine Verantwortung. Budget für Freelancer und Tools. Direkter Draht zu Gründern, Growth, Creative Direction und Produktentwicklung. Ein Headquarter in Hamburg mit Content-Studio. Hybrides Arbeiten. Gehalt 55.000 bis 80.000 € je nach Erfahrung. Und Produkte, die du selbst nutzen willst. So läuft es Ein erstes Gespräch mit Kathi (Growth) und Tim (CEO). Danach ein 60-Minuten-Case bei uns: ein Protein, sechs Geschmäcker, zwei Editionen, zwei Größen, Bundle optional — wie baust du das, was darf claim-seitig drauf und was nicht, und wie briefst du den Entwickler dafür? Your mandate is to build the legal function, establish clear decision rights and create the infrastructure that allows the company to scale without unnecessary friction. You will own legal end to end, from corporate and commercial through to export control, IP and product regulation. The remit is broad because we sell sophisticated, regulated hardware internationally and are moving faster than our processes have historically allowed. This is a role for someone who enjoys both the legal and operational sides of the job: not simply answering questions, but building the frameworks, processes and decision-making structures that prevent the same questions from coming up repeatedly. What you'll do Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions. Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus. German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken. Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin. The subject matter is unusually interesting: brain-inspired computing, advanced hardware, international technology sales, export-controlled technology, research partnerships and a regulatory environment that is evolving in real time. The work environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer a competitive salary with relocation support for the right person. Veepee (ehemals vente-privee) ist eines der erfolgreichsten europäischen E-Commerce Unternehmen: Wir arbeiten eng mit über 7000 Partnermarken zusammen und bieten unseren mehr als 72 Millionen Kunden täglich neue Verkaufsaktionen an.
Von Fashion bis hin zu Lifestyle. Uns treibt die Leidenschaft für Marken. Wir möchten unsere Kunden jeden Tag begeistern und Lust auf mehr machen.

Du kennst uns nicht?
Das wollen wir ändern! Veepee - ausgesprochen [vi:pi:] - wurde 2001 in Frankreich gegründet. Mittlerweile sind wir über 5000 Mitarbeiter in 12 Ländern. Seit 2006 gibt es uns auch in Deutschland mit Büros in Düsseldorf und Berlin.
Tauche ein in unsere Markenwelt und besuche uns auf www.veepee.de.

📄 JOB DESCRIPTION
  • We are currently seeking a skilled and results-oriented Supply Chain Manager W/M to join our team, covering the BNL, Germany & UK region.
  • The Supply Chain Manager North will be responsible for leading and optimizing the end-to-end supply chain operations for the BNL, German and UK markets, ensuring operational excellence, cost efficiency, and high service levels.
  • As a key member of the regional leadership team, the role will drive execution performance across sourcing, logistics, supplier management, and distribution activities while collaborating closely with global operational teams and the Supply Chain Excellence Center.

    • 🎯 TASKS

    Leadership Management

    • Lead and develop the regional supply chain team, fostering a collaborative, performance-driven, and innovative working environment while supporting team development and engagement.

      • Supplier Relationship Management

      • Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and logistics partners, negotiating favorable terms and ensuring reliable and efficient supply chain flows.

        • Brand & 3PL Negotiation

        • Lead negotiations and integrations with brands and 3PL providers, securing favorable commercial and operational terms while strengthening long-term partnerships.

          • Operational Execution

          • Ensure efficient end-to-end supply chain operations from supplier coordination to final delivery, guaranteeing optimal service levels and operational reliability.

            • Cost Management

            • Identify and implement opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce supply chain costs while maintaining service quality and delivery performance.

              • Performance Metrics

              • Define, monitor, and analyze supply chain KPIs to track operational performance and identify improvement opportunities.

                • Risk Management

                • Proactively identify potential supply chain disruptions and develop mitigation plans to ensure business continuity.

                  • Logistics and Distribution

                  • Collaborate closely with transportation internal teams, internal warehouses, and external dropshippers to ensure timely and cost-effective product delivery across the different markets.

    👉 MUST HAVE skills
    • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus.
    • Proven experience (+10 years) in Supply Chain management, operations, or production with strong execution capabilities.
    • Strong leadership experience managing operational teams.
    • Excellent negotiation and communication skills, with proven experience negotiating with brands and 3PL providers.
    • Demonstrated ability to manage both internal and external negotiations, building strong relationships with suppliers, brands, and internal stakeholders.
    • Solid knowledge of dropshipping operations and models.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset.
    • Knowledge of logistics operations, distribution networks, and supply chain regulations.
    • Fluency in English is required. Fluency in French,Dutch or German is a strong plus.

    👉 NICE TO HAVE skills
  • Experience in e-commerce or retail supply chain environments.
  • Experience working in international or matrix organizations.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and AI automations.
    •  

    ✅ BENEFITS
  • 👉Variable bonus
  • 👉Flexible Office with up to 2 days at home
  • 👉Online language learning Platform
  • 👉50% financial support for gym and sports club memberships
  • 👉Full monthly payment of the "Deutschlandticket" (local transport ticket)
  • 👉Medical supplementary insurance
    •  

    ❓ TEAM, WHO WE ARE ?
  • The North Supply Chain team is responsible for ensuring efficient execution of supply chain operations for the BNL and German markets, from supplier coordination to final delivery.
  • The Supply Chain Manager North leads the regional operational team and works closely with central teams, logistics partners, and the Supply Chain Excellence Center to ensure high operational performance and continuous improvement.

title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
description: ABOUT US METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production. And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production. And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes. This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business. Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future. YOUR MISSION Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions. Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured. Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation. Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured. Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting. Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation. Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data. YOUR PROFILE 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics WHY JOIN US? You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with significant impact You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment CONTACT Discover more about METYCLE: About us | LinkedIn We look forward to receiving your application. title: Automation Engineer - PLC / Plant Control (m/f/d)
description: ABOUT US METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production. And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era. Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer. The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own. We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers. Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future. YOUR MISSION PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary YOUR PROFILE 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. raw.title: Automation Engineer - PLC / Plant Control (m/f/d)
raw.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities

  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment

title: Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d)
description: Unser Projekt für Dich: moebel.de ist eines der führenden Online-Shoppingportale für Möbel und Einrichtung in Europa. Unser neues Projekt Piqit ist ein KI-gestützter Shopping-Assistant, der die Art und Weise verändert, wie Menschen online Produkte finden und kaufen. Piqit berät den Nutzer interaktiv und findet passende Produkte aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten , vergleicht Preise über zahlreiche Shops hinweg und führt direkt zum passenden Anbieter – von Wein und Werkzeug über Elektronik und Haushaltsgeräte bis hin zu Beauty, Schmuck und Möbeln. Dafür suchen wir dich als Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d) . Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben Vom ersten Tag an mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du verantwortest die Antwortqualität von Piqit, unserem KI-gestützten Shopping-Assistant, der aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten das passende Produkt findet – und zwar von der ersten Beobachtung bis zur ausgerollten Änderung. Qualität heißt hier nicht Treffermenge, sondern Antwort: Du prüfst, ob Piqit verstanden hat, worum es geht, ob die vorgeschlagenen Produkte wirklich die richtigen sind und ob die Einordnung dazu trägt. Ursachenforschung ist deine Kerndisziplin: Wenn eine Antwort nicht überzeugt, unterscheidest du sicher, ob die passenden Produkte gar nicht gefunden wurden, ob in den Produktdaten ein Attribut fehlt oder falsch belegt ist oder ob das Modell aus guten Daten etwas Falsches gemacht hat. Du kennst die Eigenheiten von Sprachmodellen: stark bei Absicht, Nuance und Sprache, unzuverlässig bei exakten Zahlen, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität – und dabei immer überzeugend klingend. Genau dieses Gespür bringst du in jede Entscheidung ein. Hands-on statt Konzeptpapier: Prompt-Sets, Hints und Regeln schreibst und rollst du selbst aus, Attribute und Facetten schärfst du selbst nach, Testsets baust du selbst – und wiederkehrende Handgriffe automatisierst du weg, gern KI-gestützt. Du misst, was wirkt: Einzelfälle sind kein Beleg, dieselbe Anfrage kann zweimal unterschiedlich beantwortet werden. Du prüfst gegen eine feste Sammlung von Testanfragen und bewertest die Veränderung über alle hinweg. Der Weg von der Beobachtung zur Änderung ist kurz, vieles geht am selben Tag live. Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Data und Engineering: Für Themen, die tiefer in der Pipeline liegen, arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen. Was du nicht selbst umsetzen kannst, übersetzt du in fundierte Anforderungen an Engineering und Data – mit Beispielen, Zahlen und einer klaren Priorisierung. Neue Shops, neue Daten: Du begleitest die Partneranbindung, prüfst, was die Antwortqualität wirklich trägt, und sagst klar, wenn ein Sortiment noch nicht live gehen sollte. Kategorie-Management ist dein Schlüssel: Kategorien, Attribute und Facetten entscheiden mit darüber, was der Assistent über ein Produkt überhaupt weiß – und weil semantische Ähnlichkeit allein nicht reicht, sobald es um Maße, Kompatibilität oder harte Grenzen geht, legst du hier selbst mit Hand an. Deine Stärken Du kannst relevante Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle vorweisen, in der du ein Produkt wirklich vorangetrieben und nicht nur begleitet hast Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität zeichnet dich aus – du willst Dinge selbst bauen und live sehen, statt sie zu delegieren und nachzuhalten Mit Sprachmodellen hast du über gelegentliches Prompting hinaus praktisch gearbeitet: Du hast Prompts systematisch verbessert, Ergebnisse verglichen und weißt, wo diese Systeme kippen – idealerweise mit Lösungen wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Gemini Durch dein Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse erkennst du, was hinter einer Anfrage steckt und wann eine Antwort nur oberflächlich passt Du überzeugst durch eine selbstständige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und hast Lust, deine Ideen aktiv im Team einzubringen Technisch bist du anschlussfähig: Du liest eine API-Antwort, verstehst eine Datenstruktur und hast keine Scheu vor SQL – programmieren musst du nicht, selbst anpacken schon Erfahrung mit Retrieval, Ranking oder semantischer Suche sowie mit dem Aufbau von Evals und Testsets ist wünschenswert Kenntnisse in Produktdaten, Feeds, Taxonomien und Attributsystemen sind von Vorteil, ebenso Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Python sowie mit MCP- und Agenten-Anbindungen Deutsch beherrschst du verhandlungssicher, gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit Unser Angebot Dein Tagesablauf gehört dir Arbeite dann, wenn du am produktivsten bist. Ob Früh- oder Spätaufsteher: Bei uns passt du deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel an – in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team. Zeitweise Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland? Kein Problem. Dein Laptop ist dein Arbeitsplatz. Unsere Kultur ist einmalig Hier sitzen alle auf derselben Couch – unabhängig von Titel oder Rolle. Teamspirit leben wir digital und vor Ort, z. B. bei Gaming Nights, Workouts, Filmabenden oder Teamevents. Viermal im Jahr treffen wir uns zur Company Week Gemeinsam im Büro arbeiten, Projekte pushen, Pizzabende genießen und mit einer Party abschließen. Mitten in Hamburg Zentral gelegen zwischen Hauptbahnhof, Mönckebergstraße und Binnenalster – perfekt für Lunch-Dates, Pausen an der Alster oder einen Feierabendbummel. Thiru ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen im Küchen- und Haushaltsbereich und in diversen Kategorien Bestseller auf Amazon und Otto. Mit rund 60.000 Bestandskunden und über 300.000 Followern auf TikTok erreichen wir eine einmalige, kochbegeisterte Zielgruppe. Als junges E-Commerce-Startup aus dem Sauerland suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Grafikdesigner für Amazon, Shop und Otto auf Minijob-Basis (m/w/d).

Deine Aufgaben

  • Gestaltung von Produktbildern, Infografiken und Lifestyle-Motiven für unsere Listings auf Amazon, Otto und im eigenen Onlineshop
  • Erstellung und Pflege von A+ Content, Brand Stores und Markenseiten nach unserer Corporate Identity
  • Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Midjourney, Adobe Firefly oder Photoshop Generative Fill für Bildbearbeitung, Hintergründe und Motivvarianten
  • Gestaltung von Werbemitteln für Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display und Social Media
  • Unterstützung bei Verpackungsdesign, Beilegern und Anleitungen für neue Produkte
  • Anpassung bestehender Grafiken an Marktplatz-Vorgaben und für internationale Märkte
  • Abstimmung mit dem Produkt- und Marketingteam zu Launches und saisonalen Aktionen

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

Erste Erfahrung im Grafikdesign, am besten in einem jungen Unternehmen mit ähnlicher Motivation. Wir sind keine Workaholics, aber erwarten Begeisterung für das Unternehmen.

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation & Selbstverantwortung
  • Leidenschaft für strukturiertes Arbeiten – Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten und Deadlines über verschiedene Kanäle hinweg den Überblick
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign oder vergleichbaren Tools wie Figma und Canva
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Bildgenerierung und -bearbeitung wie Midjourney, Adobe Firefly oder Photoshop Generative Fill
  • Spaß daran, Dich schnell in die Gestaltungsvorgaben unterschiedlicher Plattformen einzudenken (Amazon Seller Central, Otto Partner Connect, TikTok, Instagram)
  • Idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit Amazon-Content wie Produktbildern, A+ Content oder Brand Stores
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Bildsprache, Typografie und Farben sowie für das, was eine kochbegeisterte Zielgruppe anspricht
  • Du begeisterst Dich für neue Technologien und aktuelle Trends im E-Commerce und in der Gestaltung, insbesondere für KI-gestützte Bild- und Videoproduktion

Benefits

  • Remote oder im Office in Olpe
  • 100% flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Sehr junges & dynamisches Team
  • Attraktive Boni bei Erreichen von Meilensteinen
  • Wir stellen dir ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget zur Verfügung
  • Vollzeitstelle & Führungsposition in naher Zukunft möglich

title: Vertriebsleiter (m/w/d)
description: Werden Sie Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens und übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung und Skalierung unseres gesamten Vertriebs. Als Vertriebsleiter / Head of Sales (m/w/d) führen Sie nicht nur unser Vertriebsteam, sondern verantworten das gesamte Vertriebsergebnis – vom eingehenden Lead über Kontakt, Beratung und Angebot bis zum profitablen Auftrag. Ihr Ziel ist es, Strukturen zu schaffen, mit denen unser Vertrieb planbar, messbar und unabhängig von einzelnen Personen erfolgreich wächst. Dabei entwickeln Sie bestehende Prozesse weiter, etablieren klare Vertriebsstandards und KPIs, verbessern Abschlussquoten und Forecasting und entwickeln unsere Mitarbeiter durch konsequentes Coaching zu einem leistungsstarken Vertriebsteam. Wenn Sie unternehmerisches Denken, ausgeprägte Führungskompetenz und ein tiefes Verständnis für zahlengetriebenen Vertrieb miteinander verbinden, erwartet Sie bei uns eine Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die weitere Unternehmensentwicklung. und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase von Premium Solarglas. Führung des Vertriebsteams: Führung, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung von Innen- und Außendienst durch klare Ziele, regelmäßiges Coaching, Call-Reviews und verbindliche Vertriebsstandards. Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Funnel: Steuerung und Optimierung des Vertriebsprozesses von Lead → Kontakt → Termin → Beratung → Angebot → Auftrag . Vertriebscontrolling & KPIs: Steuerung anhand relevanter Kennzahlen wie Auftragseingang, Deckungsbeitrag, Abschlussquote, Lead-to-Termin-Rate, Show Rate, Umsatz je Verkäufer und Forecast Accuracy. Prozessoptimierung & Digitalisierung: Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Vertriebsprozesse sowie Weiterentwicklung von CRM, Automatisierungen, digitalen Angeboten und Nachfassprozessen. Recruiting & Mitarbeiterentwicklung: Auswahl und strukturiertes Onboarding neuer Vertriebsmitarbeiter sowie gezielte Weiterentwicklung und Leistungssteuerung des bestehenden Teams. Kunden- & Verkaufsqualität: Sicherstellung einer professionellen Beratung, hoher Kundenzufriedenheit und konsequenter Verkaufsqualität sowie Ausbau von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen. Skalierung & Marktausbau: Entwicklung neuer Vertriebskanäle, Zielgruppen und Partnerschaften sowie Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen für weiteres Unternehmenswachstum. Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing, Produktion, Operations, Finance und IT zur optimalen Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses. Ihr übergeordnetes Ziel: Sie schaffen einen planbaren, profitablen und skalierbaren Vertrieb, der durch klare Prozesse, belastbare Zahlen und ein leistungsstarkes Team nachhaltig wächst. description: <h3><strong>Ärzt:innen digitalisieren, Praxis für Praxis: Dein Gebiet, Dein Business</strong></h3> <p>Du machst Neukundengeschäft, weil Dir der Abschluss Spaß macht, nicht das Verwalten von Bestandskund:innen? Dann ist das hier Deine Rolle.</p> <p>Wir suchen <strong>Account Executives im Außendienst</strong> für unsere Standorte in ganz Deutschland:<strong> </strong>Dein Wohnort, Dein Gebiet.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Das ist der Job, ganz konkret</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>100 % Neukundenakquise.</strong> Du gewinnst Arztpraxen, die heute noch nicht mit Doctolib arbeiten. Keine Bestandskundenbetreuung, keine Renewals, keine Upsell-Quote auf fremden Accounts.</li> <li><strong>Echter Field Sales: Die Hälfte Deiner Woche bist Du unterwegs.</strong> Du sitzt bei Ärzt:innen im Sprechzimmer, nicht in Videocalls. Rund 40 Kundentermine pro Monat in Deinem Gebiet. Die andere Hälfte Deiner Woche arbeitest Du von daheim oder aus Deinem regionalen Office: Vorbereitung, Telefonakquise, Pipeline-Pflege.</li> <li><strong>Dein Gebiet, Deine Verantwortung.</strong> Du bekommst ein festes Vertriebsgebiet rund um Deinen Wohnort und steuerst es wie ein eigenes Business: Routenplanung, Priorisierung, Pipeline, Umsatz (MRR) und Kundenbeziehungen.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Ziele, die erreichbar sind:</strong> 8 bis 10 Abschlüsse pro Monat entsprechen 100 % Zielerreichung. Unser Produkt löst ein echtes Problem, das merkst Du im Gespräch.</li> <li><strong>Voller Sales-Cycle in Deiner Hand.</strong> Von der Kaltakquise über den Termin bis zum Abschluss. Kein Nice-to-have, sondern Entlastung in einem überlasteten System.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Was Du verdienst</strong></h3> <h4><strong>On-Target Earnings: 70.000 bis 80.000 €</strong></h4> <ul> <ul> <li>Fixgehalt: 50.000 bis 58.000 €</li> <li>Bonus bei 100 % Ziel: 22.000 €</li> </ul> <li><strong>Rund 70 % Deines Zielgehalts sind Fixum.</strong> Im Außendienst ist ein 50/50-Split üblich, bei uns steht der größere Teil sicher.</li> <li><strong>Ungedeckeltes Bonusmodell mit 1,5x bis 2x Overperformance-Kicker.</strong> Übererfüllung wird überproportional bezahlt, nicht abgeschnitten. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members across UK and India</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h3> <p>Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.</p> <p>You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.</p> <p>As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:</p> <ul> <li>Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms</li> <li>Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London</li> <li>Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you</li> <li>Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering</li> <li>Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows</li> <li>Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring</li> <li>Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework</li> <li>Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member</li> <li>Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap</li> <li>Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated</li> </ul> <p>This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain</li> <li>Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation</li> <li>Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators</li> <li>Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality</li> <li>Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities</li> <li>Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation –&nbsp; Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).</li> <li>Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Volunteering &amp; Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.</li> <li>Learning &amp; Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.&nbsp;</p> <div id="message-list_1777351501.983109"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote</span></div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences.
