description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Le contexte   La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout. Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.   Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur : 1. Analyse de documents 2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques 3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation   C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.   Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack  sur Github !   A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :) Les missions 🛠 Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets. Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien. Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production. Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles. Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective. Le profil idéal 👀 Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent). Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit. Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire. Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie. Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits. Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée. Les à côtés du poste 👁 Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour : 🤝  Partager des connaissances  : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,… 🎯  Proposer des évolutions  : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre   Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻  recrutement  : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens. Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert. Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. raw.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.
Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.
 
Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :
1. Analyse de documents
2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation
 
C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
  • Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
  • Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
  • Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
  • Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
  • Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
  • Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
  • Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
  • Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
  • Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
    •  
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

title: Public Sector Sales Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how we win, and what we need to build to get there</li> <li>Be the senior face of Anthropic to the French State, building trusted relationships with ministerial cabinets, senior officials and digital and technology leaders across the largest ministries, including defence, finance and justice</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle on our first strategic public sector opportunities, from first engagement through procurement route, close, deployment and expansion</li> <li>Work with Partnerships, Legal and Finance to put in place the routes to market the State needs, including resale and partner channels, framework agreements and central purchasing bodies such as UGAP</li> <li>Partner day to day with our Public Policy lead in France so that commercial and policy engagement reinforce each other, and stay aligned with French and European AI strategy and regulation</li> <li>Lead the conversation with customers on data sovereignty, security and compliance (for example SecNumCloud and the State's cloud doctrine), and work with Security, Legal and Product on how we meet those requirements</li> <li>Prove value with customers alongside a shared Applied AI architect, cloud providers and systems integrators, doing much of the groundwork yourself in the early stages</li> <li>Learn from and contribute to our UK and US public sector teams, bringing what works to France and sharing what you learn</li> <li>Create the playbooks, references and operating rhythm that will let us scale a public sector team in France over time</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>15+ years in enterprise technology sales, including significant time running a public sector business unit or leading sales teams that sell to French central government</li> <li>The appetite to move from a leadership role into a hands-on senior individual contributor role with no team at the outset</li> <li>Evidence that you thrive building from zero: a new market, a new business line or an early-stage company, where systems, processes and support were not yet in place</li> <li>A track record of landing large, complex and genuinely transformative agreements with major ministries, as the person leading the deal</li> <li>A deep, senior network across central government, and the credibility to engage at director and cabinet level as well as with technical teams</li> <li>Practical command of French public procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, central purchasing bodies and partner or resale routes</li> <li>Real expertise in data sovereignty, security and compliance requirements in the French State, and experience leading those conversations with customers</li> <li>Experience of, or a clear aptitude for, working closely with public policy or government affairs colleagues</li> <li>Ownership and resilience: you treat what is missing as something to build, and you bring colleagues with you to build it</li> <li>The technical curiosity to learn our products in depth and hold credible conversations with both engineering leaders and senior officials</li> <li>Fluent French and English, with excellent written and spoken communication in both</li> <li>Willingness to go through French security clearance (habilitation) should specific accounts require it&nbsp;</li> <li>A genuine commitment to safe and beneficial AI, and the ability to articulate why it matters for public institutions</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>À propos du poste</strong></h2> <p>En tant que Responsable des ventes secteur public d'Anthropic pour la France, vous incarnerez Anthropic auprès de l'État français. Il s'agit d'un poste fondateur, à construire de zéro : il n'existe aujourd'hui aucune équipe secteur public en France, et vous bâtirez notre stratégie, nos voies d'accès au marché et nos premières relations stratégiques en partant d'une page blanche. Ce poste est rattaché à la direction EMEA Sud. Vous piloterez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre au sein de l'administration centrale, en commençant par les plus grands ministères. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec notre responsable des affaires publiques à Paris — dans peu d'entreprises les politiques publiques sont aussi centrales à la mission que chez Anthropic — ainsi qu'avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique, Sécurité et Produit, afin de mettre en place les cadres commerciaux et de conformité dont l'État a besoin pour travailler avec nous à grande échelle.</p> <p>Il s'agit d'un poste senior de contribution individuelle. Nous attendons de vous que vous ayez dirigé une activité secteur public et encadré des équipes, et que la perspective de revenir à un poste pleinement opérationnel vous enthousiasme : un poste où vous construisez vous-même, et où la taille de votre équipe ne dit rien de l'étendue de votre périmètre. accords stratégiques.</p> <h2><strong>Responsabilités</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Définir et porter la stratégie de mise sur le marché d'Anthropic pour le secteur public en France : nos premiers terrains <li>Piloter l'intégralité du cycle de vente sur nos premières opportunités stratégiques dans le secteur public, du premier contact au choix de la voie de passation, jusqu'à la signature, au déploiement et à l'extension</li> <li>Travailler avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique et Finance pour mettre en place les voies d'accès au marché dont l'État a besoin : canaux de revente et de exigences</li> <li>Démontrer la valeur auprès des clients en vous appuyant sur une expertise d'architecture Applied AI mutualisée, sur les fournisseurs cloud et sur les intégrateurs, en réalisant vous-même une grande part du travail de terrain dans les premiers temps</li> <li>Apprendre de nos équipes secteur public au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis et contribuer à leur travail, en important en France ce qui fonctionne et en partageant vos enseignements</li> <li>Créer les playbooks, les références clients et le rythme opérationnel qui nous permettront de faire grandir une équipe secteur public en France</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Ce poste peut vous correspondre si vous réunissez</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Plus de 15 ans dans la vente de technologies aux grandes organisations, dont une période significative à la tête d'une activité secteur public ou à l'encadrement d'équipes commerciales à destination de l'administration centrale française</li> <li>L'envie de passer d'un poste d'encadrement à un poste senior pleinement opérationnel, en contribution individuelle et sans équipe au départ</li> <li>Un parcours qui montre que vous vous épanouissez en construisant à partir de zéro : un nouveau marché, une nouvelle ligne d'activité ou une entreprise à ses débuts, là où les systèmes, les processus et les soutiens n'existaient pas encore</li> <li>Des accords majeurs, complexes et réellement transformateurs conclus avec de grands ministères à votre actif, en étant la personne à la tête de la négociation</li> <li>Un réseau dense et de haut niveau au sein de l'administration centrale, et la crédibilité nécessaire pour échanger au niveau des directions et des cabinets comme avec les équipes techniques</li> <li>Une maîtrise concrète de la commande publique française : appels d'offres, accords-cadres, centrales d'achat et voies de partenariat ou de revente</li> <li>Une véritable expertise des exigences de souveraineté des données, de sécurité et de conformité au sein de l'État français, et l'expérience de ces échanges avec les clients</li> <li>L'expérience — ou une aptitude manifeste — du travail en étroite collaboration avec les équipes affaires publiques ou relations institutionnelles</li> <li>Le sens de la responsabilité et la ténacité : ce qui manque est pour vous quelque chose à construire, et vous embarquez vos collègues dans cette construction</li> <li>La curiosité technique nécessaire pour apprendre nos produits en profondeur et tenir des échanges crédibles aussi bien avec les responsables d'ingénierie qu'avec les responsables publics de haut niveau</li> <li>Un français et un anglais courants, avec une excellente expression écrite et orale dans les deux langues</li> <li>La disponibilité pour engager une procédure d'habilitation de sécurité si certains comptes l'exigent</li> <li>Un engagement sincère en faveur d'une IA sûre et bénéfique, et la capacité d'expliquer pourquoi cela compte pour les institutions publiques</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

Alan exists to end the wait.

It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area or Barcelona

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.

You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive.

Why is our Vertical approach interesting?

  • Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan.

  • Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum.

  • Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction.

  • Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

#LI-DNP

raw.title: Account Executive 🇫🇷 (Small Businesses)
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (Small Businesses) job

Your mission

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

  • Smart: Leverage precise messaging and materials to educate and inspire

  • Soft: Create tailored, high-touch strategies for each prospect

  • Experience: Deliver a seamless journey that reflects Alan's customer-first approach

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

  • Shape our product evolution

  • Contribute to improving our methods and strategy

  • Participate in growth initiatives

  • Be part of a collaborative team that thinks big

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Small Businesses Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 3 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C0 level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Contribuer au développement d'une architecture de sécurité robuste qui s'aligne sur le modèle zéro trust. Renforcer la sécurité du cloud (AWS, on-prem), participer au hardening de l’infra, à la protection contre les menaces avancées et à la conception de SaaS sécurisés. Participer activement à une équipe d'ingénieurs diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs en sécurité, d'ingénieurs logiciels, de devops et de SRE. title: Stage de 6 mois UX/UI Designer (H/F/N) – PARIS
description: Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. Vous rejoignez l'équipe produit  Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design, que vous aimez transformer une donnée complexe en visuel et que vous voulez apprendre à concevoir des interfaces au service de vrais enjeux data, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics.   Ekimetrics est leader en data science et fournisseur de solutions AI. Depuis plus de 20 ans, nous utilisons la data science au service de l’optimisation de performance marketing, business et de la transition vers une performance plus durable.   Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design d’interfaces élégantes et intuitives, que vous aimez transformer des idées en prototypes concrets et que vous rêvez d’expérimenter avec l’IA, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics !   Pourquoi recrutons nous ?   L'équipe Produit conçoit des solutions data-driven et logiciels métier , centrées sur l'utilisateur, qui aident nos clients à prendre de meilleures décisions business à partir de leurs données.    Design, data science et développement travaillent main dans la main sur des problèmes concrets.    Elle compte 30 personnes (full-stack developers, Product managers, Product owners, DevOps et Product designers) qui construisent les plateformes de data science et d'IA que nos clients utilisent au quotidien pour piloter leurs décisions.  Pour accélérer la production de ces interfaces, améliorer les parcours de nos utilisateurs et recueillir leurs retours, nous recrutons un·e stagiaire UX/UI Designer, suivi·e par un product designer senior, avec une vraie autonomie sur des projets complets menés en s'appuyant sur le design system Ekimetrics, les méthodes agiles et selon la méthode du double diamant.     Le process de recrutement : Un entretien RH,  Un entretien technique sur site  Un entretien final. Est attendu un portfolio démontrant d'au moins 3 projets variés ainsi qu'une expertise Figma et UI avancés   Vos missions :   Concevoir des flows, wireframes et maquettes : pas des écrans isolés, mais des parcours qui aident nos clients à décider.   Contribuer au design system : comprendre pourquoi une règle existe avant de l'appliquer, puis la faire évoluer sans casser la cohérence entre nos produits.   Participer aux ateliers UX et aux tests d'utilisabilité (Maze), et proposer des solutions argumentées.   Travailler avec les product designers, les product owners et les développeurs.   Profil recherché :   Bac+5 en cours, en design, UX/UI ou multimédia interactif.   Vous suivez les nouveaux produits et les tendances (design systems, IA appliquée au produit, nouvelles interactions), et vous voulez comprendre pourquoi ils fonctionnent.   Vous maîtrisez Figma en profondeur (variables, auto-layout, composants).   Pour vous, un design system est un système de règles, pas une bibliothèque de composants. Une connaissance de shadcn/ui ou d'un système équivalent est un plus.   Vous défendez vos choix avec des arguments, pas seulement avec du goût.   Vous gérez seul·e votre temps et vos priorités.   Vous êtes proactif·ve et fiable sur les deadlines : vous partagez idées, doutes et avancement réel sans attendre qu'on vous le demande.   Les petits plus :   Des connaissances en accessibilité web seront appréciées Des compétences à restituer en vidéo et sous forme de slides   Modalités :    Stage de 6 mois, démarrage prévu entre janvier et mars 2027.   Software : Jira, Figma et Maze.   Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?   Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif.   Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu ,  que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.    Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.   En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.    Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !   Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.   Vous aurez accès :    Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.   A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ;   De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ;    Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards)   Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.    En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation.

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.

Vous rejoignez l'équipe produit 

Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design, que vous aimez transformer une donnée complexe en visuel et que vous voulez apprendre à concevoir des interfaces au service de vrais enjeux data, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics. 

Ekimetrics est leader en data science et fournisseur de solutions AI. Depuis plus de 20 ans, nous utilisons la data science au service de l’optimisation de performance marketing, business et de la transition vers une performance plus durable. 

Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design d’interfaces élégantes et intuitives, que vous aimez transformer des idées en prototypes concrets et que vous rêvez d’expérimenter avec l’IA, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics ! 

Pourquoi recrutons nous ? 

L'équipe Produit conçoit des solutions data-driven et logiciels métier, centrées sur l'utilisateur, qui aident nos clients à prendre de meilleures décisions business à partir de leurs données.  

Design, data science et développement travaillent main dans la main sur des problèmes concrets.  

Elle compte 30 personnes (full-stack developers, Product managers, Product owners, DevOps et Product designers) qui construisent les plateformes de data science et d'IA que nos clients utilisent au quotidien pour piloter leurs décisions. 

Pour accélérer la production de ces interfaces, améliorer les parcours de nos utilisateurs et recueillir leurs retours, nous recrutons un·e stagiaire UX/UI Designer, suivi·e par un product designer senior, avec une vraie autonomie sur des projets complets menés en s'appuyant sur le design system Ekimetrics, les méthodes agiles et selon la méthode du double diamant.  

Le process de recrutement :

  • Un entretien RH, 
  • Un entretien technique sur site 
  • Un entretien final.
Est attendu un portfolio démontrant d'au moins 3 projets variés ainsi qu'une expertise Figma et UI avancés 

Vos missions : 

  • Concevoir des flows, wireframes et maquettes : pas des écrans isolés, mais des parcours qui aident nos clients à décider. 

  • Contribuer au design system : comprendre pourquoi une règle existe avant de l'appliquer, puis la faire évoluer sans casser la cohérence entre nos produits. 

  • Participer aux ateliers UX et aux tests d'utilisabilité (Maze), et proposer des solutions argumentées. 

  • Travailler avec les product designers, les product owners et les développeurs. 

Profil recherché :  

  • Bac+5 en cours, en design, UX/UI ou multimédia interactif. 

  • Vous suivez les nouveaux produits et les tendances (design systems, IA appliquée au produit, nouvelles interactions), et vous voulez comprendre pourquoi ils fonctionnent. 

  • Vous maîtrisez Figma en profondeur (variables, auto-layout, composants). 

  • Pour vous, un design system est un système de règles, pas une bibliothèque de composants. Une connaissance de shadcn/ui ou d'un système équivalent est un plus. 

  • Vous défendez vos choix avec des arguments, pas seulement avec du goût. 

  • Vous gérez seul·e votre temps et vos priorités. 

  • Vous êtes proactif·ve et fiable sur les deadlines : vous partagez idées, doutes et avancement réel sans attendre qu'on vous le demande. 

Les petits plus : 

  • Des connaissances en accessibilité web seront appréciées
  • Des compétences à restituer en vidéo et sous forme de slides 

Modalités :  

  • Stage de 6 mois, démarrage prévu entre janvier et mars 2027. 

  • Software : Jira, Figma et Maze. 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif.  

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.  

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même. 

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.  

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.   

Vous aurez accès :  

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School. 

  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ; 

  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ;  

  • Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards) 

  • Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.  

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.

You will work across two types of engagements:

 

  1. One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)

  2. Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..

This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.




What you’ll do

  • Own the delivery of strategic consulting and analytics engagements from discovery through completion.

  • Act as the primary operational point of contact for the services being delivered to the customer.

  • Define project objectives, scope, milestones, working methods, deliverables, and success criteria.

  • Build and manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.

  • Lead managed-services engagements as the delivery owner and project manager.

  • Maintain a proactive service roadmap and identify the right missions, workshops, analyses, training sessions, and enablement activities for each customer.

  • Coordinate the work of Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants, and other specialists when required.

  • Escalate delivery risks, scope issues, capacity constraints, or customer blockers in a timely manner.

  • Ensure that customers receive measurable value from their Professional Services engagement.

  • Apply digital analytics and Contentsquare expertise

  • Analyze digital experience data and translate findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Prepare and deliver analyses, executive readouts, workshops, training sessions, and working sessions with customer teams.

  • Help customers define use cases, measurement approaches, prioritization frameworks, and roadmaps.
  • Assess data collection, tagging plans, data quality, measurement frameworks, and the conditions required for reliable analysis.
  • Use Contentsquare and other digital analytics tools to investigate customer questions and support evidence-based decisions.
  • Understand how digital analytics data can connect with broader customer data ecosystems, including business intelligence tools, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and activation platforms.
  • You are not expected to be a specialist Data Analyst or Data Architect, but you should be comfortable working with data and explaining analytical findings to both business and technical stakeholders.
    •  

    Partner with customers and internal teams

  • Facilitate discussions with operational teams, analytics teams, technical stakeholders, senior leaders, and economic buyers.

  • Work closely with the Customer Success Manager. The CSM owns the broader partnership, while you own the quality, coordination, and delivery of the services provided.

  • Collaborate across the broader Professional Services organization and contribute your expertise to team discussions, methods, and delivery standards.

  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and become a reliable advisor on their digital experience and analytics priorities.

  • Communicate complex analytical or technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of expertise.

    •  

    Identify risks and opportunities

  • Monitor customer adoption, engagement, delivery progress, and stakeholder participation.

  • Proactively identify risks such as declining adoption, missed milestones, unclear ownership, or limited use of the platform.

  • Surface relevant expansion or cross-sell opportunities to the Customer Success and Sales teams. This is not a quota-carrying sales role, but you are expected to recognize when additional Contentsquare capabilities or services could address a customer need.

  • Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics.

    • Improve how we work

  • Contribute to reusable consulting methods, frameworks, templates, and points of view.

  • Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes.

  • Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement.

  • Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team.

    •  

    What you’ll need to succeed

  • Approximately 5 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, strategic consulting, digital consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing advisory environment.

  • Experience working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments.

  • Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery.

  • Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and executive discussions.

  • Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous customer challenges clearly.

  • Practical experience with digital analytics, business intelligence, conversion optimization, customer experience analytics, or related data products.

  • Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Experience with Contentsquare is highly valuable.

  • Understanding of tagging plans, data collection, data quality, measurement frameworks, data structures, and the limitations that can affect analytical outcomes.

  • Ability to interpret data, develop an analysis, and communicate the implications and recommendations clearly.

  • Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation.

  • Ability to work independently across a changing mix of one-off missions and recurring managed-services engagements.

  • Comfortable collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other specialist teams.

  • Practical curiosity about artificial intelligence, data flows, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and modern digital analytics ecosystems.

  • Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your own work and customer delivery, while applying appropriate judgment and maintaining confidentiality.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, including the ability to lead customer conversations, workshops, and presentations in French.

  • Availability to work with customers primarily during French or Central European business hours.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements, team meetings, and company events.

    • Why you should join Contentsquare

    - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
    - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)

  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum

  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and in French

  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers
